title: Paola Rojas brings message of empowerment and unity to Nuevo Laredo
excerpt: Journalist and anchor Paola Rojas gave the conference "Juntas, todas y todos, somos más fuertes" at the Teatro Experimental del Centro Cultural in Nuevo Laredo, organized by the city government through the Instituto Municipal de la Mujer.
content:
Journalist and anchor Paola Rojas brought a message of empowerment and unity to Nuevo Laredo with the conference "Juntas, todas y todos, somos más fuertes" — "Together, all of us, we are stronger" — held at the Teatro Experimental del Centro Cultural, according to El Mañana de Nuevo Laredo.

The conference was organized by the municipal government of Nuevo Laredo through the Instituto Municipal de la Mujer (INMUJER), as part of efforts focused on eliminating violence against women and building support networks for women in the region.

The gathering centered on women's empowerment, equality and unity through dialogue and reflection, including personal development, inclusion and recognition of women's role in public and community life, El Mañana reported.

Mayor Carmen Lilia Canturosas Villarreal emphasized the importance of initiatives that strengthen women's participation in community development and public policies, and of building a society with more opportunities for all. She said the municipal government firmly believes in community unity, the strength of its people and women's participation in social and community development, and she recognized Cynthia Canturosas, the Consejo Consultivo and the INMUJER team. Building a more equal society requires the collaboration and commitment of all citizens, she said, inviting continued work from empathy, respect and joint participation.

Sources: El Mañana de Nuevo Laredo, November 9, 2026.
